```{r setup, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide', include = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library("ggplot2")
  library("readr")
  library("dplyr")
  library("tidyr")
  library("magrittr")
  library("reshape2")
  library("ggsignif")
  library("viridis")
})

# --- Data paths ---
url_manifest                 <- "../data/manifest.txt"
url_preanalytical_conditions <- "../data/pre-analytical_conditions.txt"
url_hpv_type                 <- "../data/TM-2021-MSK-002_HPV_Typing_WES_WGS.txt"
url_clinical                 <- "../data/clinical.txt"
url_mutation_summary         <- "../data/mutation_summary.maf"
url_idx_metrics_ft           <- "../data/idx_metrics_ft.txt"

target_contigs <- c(
  "HPV-16" = "NC001526.4",
  "HPV-18" = "NC001357.1",
  "HPV-31" = "J04353.1",
  "HPV-33" = "M12732.1",
  "HPV-35" = "X74477.1"
)

FRAGMENT_LENGTH_THRESHOLD <- 37

scientific_10 <- function(x) {
  parse(text = gsub("+", "", gsub("e", " %.% 10^", scales::scientific_format()(x)), fixed = TRUE))
}

# --- Helper: pivot per-patient per-timepoint data to wide abs/rel columns ---
make_wide <- function(df, value_col, prefix) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient_id_mskcc, timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(v = mean(.data[[value_col]] + 1e-5, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    reshape2::dcast(
      formula       = patient_id_mskcc ~ timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT,
      fun.aggregate = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      fill          = NaN,
      value.var     = "v"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id_mskcc, `Pre-treatment`, wk1, wk2, wk3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk1") := wk1 / `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk2") := wk2 / `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("rel_", prefix, "_wk3") := wk3 / `Pre-treatment`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk0") := `Pre-treatment`,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk1") := wk1,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk2") := wk2,
      !!paste0("abs_", prefix, "_wk3") := wk3
    )
}

# --- Helper: run univariate GLM (probit) for each variable against one outcome ---
run_glm <- function(smry_long, outcome_col) {
  uvars <- unique(smry_long$variable)
  vapply(uvars, function(v) {
    tryCatch({
      (smry_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(variable == v) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(value = log2(value)) %>%
        stats::glm(
          formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~ value")),
          data    = .,
          family  = binomial(link = "probit")
        ) %>%
        summary() %>%
        .[["coefficients"]])[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }, numeric(1))
}

# --- Helper: run Wilcoxon test for each variable against one outcome ---
run_wilcox <- function(smry_long, outcome_col) {
  uvars <- unique(smry_long$variable)
  vapply(uvars, function(v) {
    tryCatch({
      smry_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(variable == v) %>%
        wilcox.test(
          formula = as.formula(paste("value ~", outcome_col)),
          data    = .,
          exact   = FALSE
        ) %>%
        .[["p.value"]]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }, numeric(1))
}

# --- Shared outcome encoding ---
encode_outcomes <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      composite_end_point    = dplyr::if_else(composite_end_point, 1L, 0L),
      neck_dissection_yes_no = dplyr::case_when(
        neck_dissection_yes_no == "yes" ~ "1",
        neck_dissection_yes_no == "no"  ~ "0"
      ),
      hypoxia_resolution = dplyr::case_when(
        hypoxia_resolution == "persistent" ~ "1",
        hypoxia_resolution == "resolved"   ~ "0"
      )
    ) %>%
    readr::type_convert()
}
```

```{r load_shared_data, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

manifest_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_manifest, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(bam_file_name_hpv)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample_uuid = paste0(sample_id_mskcc, "-", sample_id_invitae))

preanalytical_conditions <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_preanalytical_conditions, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

hpv_smry <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_hpv_type, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_id_mskcc = gsub("-T", "", patient_name, fixed = TRUE),
    patient_id_mskcc = gsub("155salv", "155", patient_id_mskcc, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes     = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wes, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wgs     = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wgs, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_wes_wgs, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs = dplyr::coalesce(hpv_type_wes_wgs, "Unknown")
  )

manifest <- manifest_raw %>%
  dplyr::left_join(preanalytical_conditions, by = "sample_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_id_mskcc = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(patient_id_mskcc) & sample_id_mskcc == "21-144-03654" ~ "CTMS-164",
      TRUE ~ patient_id_mskcc
    ),
    sample_name = paste0(sample_id_mskcc, "-", sample_id_invitae)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hpv_smry, by = "patient_id_mskcc")

mutation_smry <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_mutation_summary, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

clinical <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_clinical, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert()

# --- Per-sample mutation AF summary ---
mut_af_smry <- mutation_smry %>%
  dplyr::filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_af = mean(t_maf), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(sample_name = Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

# --- Index metrics at target fragment length ---
idx_metrics_ft <- readr::read_tsv(
  url_idx_metrics_ft, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) %>%
  readr::type_convert() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name     = SAMPLE_NAME,
    contig          = CHROMOSOME,
    aligned_reads   = ALIGNED_READS,
    fragment_length = FRAGMENT_LENGTH
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::tibble(contig = target_contigs, chromosome = names(target_contigs)),
    by = "contig"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(fragment_length == FRAGMENT_LENGTH_THRESHOLD, !is.na(chromosome)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(manifest, by = "sample_name") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::select(clinical, patient_id_mskcc, hpv_type_panel),
    by = "patient_id_mskcc"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hpv_type_panel         = gsub("HPV", "HPV-", hpv_type_panel, fixed = TRUE),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = dplyr::case_when(
      hpv_type_wes_wgs == "Unknown" ~ hpv_type_panel,
      TRUE ~ hpv_type_wes_wgs
    ),
    hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = dplyr::coalesce(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel, "Unknown")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(chromosome == hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mut_af_smry, by = "sample_name") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = floor(timepoint_days_since_start_of_RT / 7),
    timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT = dplyr::case_when(
      timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT < 0 ~ "Pre-treatment",
      TRUE ~ paste0("wk", timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT)
    )
  )
```

```{r build_summaries, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

# --- Shared wide columns (MRI uses one-week imaging offset) ---
common_select <- function(df, extra_ids = character(0)) {
  dplyr::select(df,
    all_of(c("patient_id_mskcc", extra_ids)),
    composite_end_point, neck_dissection_yes_no, hypoxia_resolution,
    abs_AF_wk0,  abs_AF_wk1,  abs_AF_wk2,  abs_AF_wk3,
    rel_AF_wk1,  rel_AF_wk2,  rel_AF_wk3,
    abs_HPV_wk0, abs_HPV_wk1, abs_HPV_wk2, abs_HPV_wk3,
    rel_HPV_wk1, rel_HPV_wk2, rel_HPV_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk0 = MRI_rawdata_wk0,
    abs_MRI_wk1 = MRI_rawdata_wk2,   # one-week imaging offset
    abs_MRI_wk2 = MRI_rawdata_wk3,
    abs_MRI_wk3 = MRI_rawdata_wk4
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rel_MRI_wk1 = abs_MRI_wk1 / abs_MRI_wk0,
      rel_MRI_wk2 = abs_MRI_wk2 / abs_MRI_wk0,
      rel_MRI_wk3 = abs_MRI_wk3 / abs_MRI_wk0
    )
}

wide_af  <- make_wide(idx_metrics_ft, "mean_af",       "AF")
wide_hpv <- make_wide(dplyr::filter(idx_metrics_ft, hpv_type_wes_wgs == "HPV-16"), "aligned_reads", "HPV")

# Training set: HPV-16 patients only, long format
smry_train <- wide_af %>%
  dplyr::full_join(wide_hpv, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::full_join(clinical, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  common_select() %>%
  encode_outcomes() %>%
  dplyr::select(-patient_id_mskcc) %>%
  reshape2::melt(
    id.vars = c("composite_end_point", "neck_dissection_yes_no", "hypoxia_resolution")
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

# Test set: non-HPV-16 patients (validated on HPV panel type), retains patient_id
wide_af_test  <- make_wide(idx_metrics_ft, "mean_af",       "AF")
wide_hpv_test <- make_wide(idx_metrics_ft, "aligned_reads", "HPV")

smry_test <- wide_af_test %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    idx_metrics_ft %>%
      dplyr::group_by(patient_id_mskcc, timepoint_weeks_since_start_of_RT) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel = unique(hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::distinct(patient_id_mskcc, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "patient_id_mskcc"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(wide_hpv_test, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  dplyr::full_join(clinical, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
  common_select(extra_ids = "hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel") %>%
  encode_outcomes() %>%
  reshape2::melt(
    id.vars = c("patient_id_mskcc", "hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel",
                "composite_end_point", "neck_dissection_yes_no", "hypoxia_resolution")
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

# --- Univariate association tests on training set ---
uvars <- unique(smry_train$variable)

baseline_rows <- dplyr::tibble(
  variables              = rep(c("rel_AF_wk0", "rel_MRI_wk0", "rel_HPV_wk0"), 2),
  `De-escalation failure` = 1,
  `PET response`          = 1,
  `Risk group`            = 1,
  Method                  = rep(c("log", "u"), each = 3)
)

res_ <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::tibble(
    variables              = uvars,
    `De-escalation failure` = run_glm(smry_train, "neck_dissection_yes_no"),
    `PET response`          = run_glm(smry_train, "hypoxia_resolution"),
    `Risk group`            = run_glm(smry_train, "composite_end_point"),
    Method                  = "log"
  ),
  dplyr::tibble(
    variables              = uvars,
    `De-escalation failure` = run_wilcox(smry_train, "neck_dissection_yes_no"),
    `PET response`          = run_wilcox(smry_train, "hypoxia_resolution"),
    `Risk group`            = run_wilcox(smry_train, "composite_end_point"),
    Method                  = "u"
  ),
  baseline_rows
)
```

```{r build_plots_S13, eval = TRUE, include = FALSE}

# --- Helper: shared training/validation box+jitter plot for one variable ---
# val_var:    variable name to filter from smry_train / smry_test (e.g. "abs_HPV_wk2")
# y_expr:     expression passed to aes(y = ...) (e.g. quote(100 * value))
# y_scale:    a scale_y_* call
# y_lab:      y-axis label string or expression
# sig_y:      y_position for both geom_signif calls
# val_filter: optional extra filter on smry_test (default: hpv_type_wes_wgs != "HPV-16")
validation_plot <- function(val_var, y_expr, y_scale, y_lab, sig_y,
                            val_filter = quote(hpv_type_wes_wgs != "HPV-16")) {
  test_rows <- smry_test %>%
    dplyr::left_join(hpv_smry, by = "patient_id_mskcc") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!!val_filter) %>%
    dplyr::filter(variable == val_var) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      composite_end_point = factor(composite_end_point, levels = c(0, 1), ordered = TRUE),
      group               = "Validation"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(composite_end_point, neck_dissection_yes_no, hypoxia_resolution, variable, value, group)

  smry_train %>%
    dplyr::filter(variable == val_var) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      composite_end_point = factor(composite_end_point, levels = c(0, 1), ordered = TRUE),
      group               = "Training"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(test_rows) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      composite_end_point = factor(composite_end_point),
      group               = factor(group)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = composite_end_point, y = !!y_expr)) +
    geom_boxplot(stat = "boxplot", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      mapping = aes(x = composite_end_point, y = !!y_expr, color = group),
      width = 0.1, shape = 21, fill = "white", alpha = 1, size = 2
    ) +
    scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 7) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low", "High")) +
    y_scale +
    xlab("Risk group") +
    ylab(y_lab) +
    geom_signif(
      data        = . %>% dplyr::filter(group == "Training"),
      mapping     = aes(x = composite_end_point, y = !!y_expr),
      stat        = "signif",
      comparisons = list(c("0", "1")),
      test        = "wilcox.test",
      test.args   = list(alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE),
      linewidth   = 0.55, textsize = 4, color = "#66c2a5",
      vjust       = -0.5, y_position = sig_y
    ) +
    geom_signif(
      data        = . %>% dplyr::filter(group == "Validation"),
      mapping     = aes(x = composite_end_point, y = !!y_expr),
      stat        = "signif",
      comparisons = list(c("0", "1")),
      test        = "wilcox.test",
      test.args   = list(alternative = "less", exact = FALSE),
      linewidth   = 0.55, textsize = 4, color = "#fc8d62",
      vjust       = -0.5, y_position = sig_y
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x     = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 20), size = 12),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 20), size = 12),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.background = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~group)
}

# --- S13a: cfDNA aligned HPV read pairs at week 2 ---
# Validation uses HPV panel type (hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel == "HPV-16") for non-HPV-16 WES patients
plot_chpv <- validation_plot(
  val_var    = "abs_HPV_wk2",
  y_expr     = quote(100 * value),
  y_scale    = scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(1e2, 1e12),
    breaks = c(1e2, 1e4, 1e6, 1e8, 1e10),
    labels = scientific_10
  ),
  y_lab      = "cfDNA Aligned HPV Read Pairs",
  sig_y      = 0.975 * log10(3e11),
  val_filter = quote(hpv_type_wes_wgs != "HPV-16" & hpv_type_wes_wgs_panel == "HPV-16")
)

# --- S13b: mean AF at week 2 ---
plot_ctdna <- validation_plot(
  val_var    = "abs_AF_wk2",
  y_expr     = quote(100 * value),
  y_scale    = scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(NA, 100),
    breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
    labels = scientific_10
  ),
  y_lab      = "ctDNA Fraction (%)",
  sig_y      = 1.5 * log10(10)
)

# --- S13c: MRI tumor volume at week 2 ---
plot_mri <- validation_plot(
  val_var    = "abs_MRI_wk2",
  y_expr     = quote((100 * value) / 1000),
  y_scale    = scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(1e4, 1e8) / 1000,
    breaks = c(1e4, 1e5, 1e6, 1e7) / 1000,
    labels = scientific_10(c(1e2, 1e3, 1e4, 1e5) / 1000)
  ),
  y_lab      = expression("MRI Volume " (cm^3)),
  sig_y      = 0.95 * log10(7e7 / 1000)
)
